preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 50,000 inclusive.
The old capital r1 is a valid city index between 1 and n inclusive.
The new capital r2 is a valid city index between 1 and n inclusive.
The old capital r1 is different from the new capital r2.
The list p contains exactly n - 1 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in p is a valid city index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The new representation new_p contains exactly n - 1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in new_p)
postconditions.description: Each element in the new representation new_p is a valid city index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(new_p[i-1] == r2 if i == r2 else new_p[i-1] in path_to_r2(i, new_p) for i in range(1, n+1) if i != r2)
postconditions.description: For each city i (except the new capital r2), new_p[i-1] is the last city on the way from the new capital r2 to city i.
